CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_community_fingerprint(c community_shots)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select pg_catalog.md5(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(
  c.coffee_id,c.style,c.dose_g,c.yield_g,c.time_s,c.temperature_c,
  c.extraction,c.body,c.clarity,c.sweetness,c.astringency,c.grind_setting,
  c.feed_mode,c.observed_on,c.machine_model,c.grinder_model,c.burr_set,
  c.basket_model,c.basket_dose_g
 )::text);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_on_library_coffee_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if old.coffee_id is distinct from new.coffee_id then
  perform private.dic_backfill_library_contributions(
    new.owner_id,new.id,new.coffee_id);
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

records.name: dic_admin_access_overview
records.visible_ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_admin_access_overview()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not private.is_admin() then
  raise exception using errcode='42501', message='Administrator access required.';
 end if;
 return jsonb_build_object(
  'invites_total',(select count(*) from private.beta_invites),
  'invites',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',i.id,'label',i.label,'created_at',i.created_at,
      'expires_at',i.expires_at,'revoked_at',i.revoked_at,
      'uses',i.uses,'max_uses',i.max_uses,
      'status',case
       when i.revoked_at is not null then 'revoked'
       when i.expires_at is not null and i.expires_at<=now() then 'expired'
       when i.max_uses is not null and i.uses>=i.max_uses then 'used'
       else 'active' end
    ) order by i.created_at desc,i.id desc)
    from (select id,label,created_at,expires_at,revoked_at,uses,max_uses
     from private.beta_invites order by created_at desc,id desc limit 50) i
   ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'members_total',(select count(*) from private.beta_members where admitted_at is not null),
  'members',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',m.owner_id,'email',u.email,'enabled',m.enabled,
      'admin',a.owner_id is not null,'admitted_at',m.admitted_at
    ) order by (a.owner_id is not null) desc,m.admitted_at desc,m.owner_id)
    from (
      select owner_id,enabled,admitted_at from private.beta_members
      where admitted_at is not null order by admitted_at desc,owner_id limit 50
    ) m
    join auth.users u on u.id=m.owner_id
    left join private.app_admins a on a.owner_id=m.owner_id
   ),'[]'::jsonb)
 );
end $function$
